desc: Derive the sweep-line invariant for counting valid subarrays ending at each right endpoint.
Design efficient tracking of the largest and second-largest active left endpoints with pair identities.
Prove that a pair gains the gap between the top two restrictions exactly when it uniquely determines the maximum.
Handle duplicate/equal left endpoints, pair ordering, and removal of exactly one pair.
Implement and test the O(n + m) Python solution against examples, edge cases, and brute-force random cases.
